verdict.rationale:
CrewAI's docs describe a unified Memory system that replaces separate short-term, long-term, entity, and external memory types with one API, using LLM-based scoring for adaptive recall across semantic similarity, recency, and importance — directly supporting persistent, cross-session agent memory. This is documented as a core, first-party feature rather than an add-on.
missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that memory actually persists across separate process runs/threads, and details on storage backend/configuration for long-term persistence.
